If your tracking shows delivered but you didn’t receive the package, try these steps:
Check around your home (front door, porch, package lockers, side entrances) in case the carrier left it nearby.
Review the tracking details to confirm the delivery address and any delivery notes or photos.
Contact the shipping carrier listed on the tracking and file a missing package claim using your tracking number.
Sometimes “delivered” can also mean the package reached a local carrier hub and the final delivery is still being scheduled.
